rows.stoppedReason: ROUTE_OPTIONS cannot be discharged without editing the shared finalizer, which this lane is forbidden to touch. JDF 478 section 3 prints 'Colorado Bureau of Investigation (required)' and the route settles it, so the builder now asks the finalizer to mark 478.3D.0 through its existing selectionsFromHeldFacts channel. The finalizer runs protectCategoryOf() on the field's label before it will mark anything, and the truthful label — 'Colorado Bureau of Investigation records to be sealed (selection)' — matches the shared `agency` protect rule on the word 'Bureau'. The refusal comes back as protected_category/agency. There is no per-call exemption: the only allowlist is the module constant PARTICIPANT_STATED_SUBJECT in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-field-semantics.mjs, and adding an entry there would move every family that shares the module. The box was NOT relabelled to get past the gate; a label chosen to dodge a protect rule is the defect the gate exists to catch. Consequence: requiredOptionsMissing is 1, so the nine counters are NOT all zero for this family.

rows.stoppedReason: ROUTE_OPTIONS is repaired for one of its two elections and cannot be completed for the other. JDF-417/Title is now on the delivered page. JDF-417/4B.0 is not, and nothing in the shared instrument can put it there: 4B.0 is a /Ch dropdown with options [' ', 'Yes.', 'No.'], and the finalizer reaches a choice control only through a value resolved from an ALLOWLISTED FACT, while selectionsFromHeldFacts is checkbox-only. No allowlisted fact answers a sworn yes-or-no question, and this build will not invent one to put a sworn answer on a petition the participant signs. The refusal is measured and recorded rather than described as a write, and the answer the route implies is named for the participant. Whether that discharges ROUTE_OPTIONS is an independent verifier's call, not this lane's; the row is left STOPPED rather than self-certified.
whatChanged: KNOWN_PREFILLS: the field map declared two writes that did not exist. Both are corrected against the bytes. JDF-417/Title claimed statedByThePacket 'Petition' while the delivered page-1 title read 'to Seal Arrest and Criminal Records' — the court's own word for what the document IS, removed from a filing. Title is a /Ch dropdown the Colorado Judicial Department ships selected on 'Petition' and draws with the form's own /AP; the finalizer's structural rule drops the value and widget of every unwritten choice control, which is right for an unanswered chooser and wrong for a title. A registry entry co_petition_seal_arrest-set:JDF-417.Title = preserve_source_appearance, passed through the finalizer's existing appearanceDispositions option, keeps the issuer's word on the issuer's form. It is preservation, not a write: canonicalWrites does not grow and reports/actual-writes.json records it as a documentAuthoredAppearance.
